comments.body: The reaction object is always created with the CONNECTED flag (f: type | DIRTY | CONNECTED). CONNECTED is meant to indicate that a reaction is part of an effect tree (i.e., an effect or a derived that is depended on by an effect). Adding it to every reaction, including pure deriveds that have no dependents, incorrectly marks them as connected. This prevents deriveds from being treated as unconnected and can stop them from being marked MAYBE_DIRTY, breaking the intended reconnection logic and potentially causing stale values.

The reconnect function toggles the CONNECTED flag using XOR (derived.f ^= CONNECTED). This will incorrectly clear the flag if the derived is already connected, causing it to become disconnected again. It should set the flag (derived.f |= CONNECTED) instead of toggling.
